[[Meynsang's Longbow]] is a [[unique item]] dropped by [[Meynsang the Sadistic]], a [[boss]] found in [[Pongmei Valley]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Bleeding]] [[duration]] on foes by 33%
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item shares the same [[skin]] as the [[Wooden Longbow]] [[dye]]d green.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Longbow (wooden)|Longbow]] from collectors [[Mathilde]] or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Barbed]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Green [[dye]]


Except for the [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.
*[[Wooden Longbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*Barbed Bow String
*Perfect Bow Grip of Fortitude
*Perfect [["To the Pain!"]] inscription
*Green [[dye]]
